The idea

Remember the engraved bricks at hospitals? The named tiles at zoos?

People love finding their name and bringing someone to see it.

We took that idea online. Every donation adds something to a larger picture: a paw print, a footprint, a leaf, or a piece of an image that slowly reveals itself. Donors find their name, share the page, and see what they're helping create together.

And when someone new wants in, the page takes them straight to your donation page.

Leaf walls, tile murals, flocks of birds: organizations get wonderfully creative with this. Ours is virtual, and it grows the moment a gift comes in.

“

EVERYONE was able to see who donated and wanted their own handprint! It was the perfect enticement to bring in donors.

Cheryl Mitchell · Producer, I Saw the Children Gather

It started with a quilt.

For a documentary about Harand Camp, we created a digital quilt inspired by the camp's handprint tradition. Every donation added another handprint. People visited the page, found theirs, and watched the quilt grow.

It worked better than we imagined.

See the Harand quilt →Support the film and become part of the quilt →
How it works

Beautiful for donors. Simple for your team.

01

Someone donates.

Through whatever platform you already use. Nothing changes.

02

You add their name.

Open your private Add page, type the name, click Add.

03

The picture grows.

Refresh, and their name is part of your design.

04

You say thanks.

Click Thank them. A personalized email opens in your inbox, link included. Hit send: a second moment with every donor.

Not everyone wants their name up. So the form asks.

One line on your donation form, and donors answer in their own words.

How would you like to appear?

That's it. No new platform, no software to learn. You can do it from your phone, and a whole list of names pastes in at once.

A little about us

Hi, we're Presentora!

We're a Chicago creative studio. What we do best is take complex ideas and make them crystal clear, and we love helping companies do exactly that.

I'm Angelica, the founder. I've spent more than 15 years creating presentations and visual experiences for teams at organizations including Apple, Microsoft, McKinsey, Accenture, Disney, and Make-A-Wish.

This whole idea started when a friend asked me to help thank the donors for her documentary. We made the handprint quilt, saw how much people loved being part of it, and thought: why not make this available to other organizations?

That's how this little idea grew.

Every page is designed by people, around your cause, with simple technology behind the scenes. And when you reach out, you're talking with a real person on our team.
